dialogue: What’s a wisp? Okay, see that starting totem?
Some snarky firefly flew through here and recorded their time using magic or something.
There’s a finish point up ahead: you race from the start to end!
When you beat their time, get a reward.
They kinda cheat though... since like they can fly.
But I can still find ways to move just as fast!
The first time you beat one, they give you a prize.
On the rematch they really try, so it's ok if you don’t win right away.
This one’s tough. I already beat them once, but the rematch is hard.
I met a [color=#f8c868]Bee[/color] who beat ALL of them, so it’s possible.
It’s fun, I like proving wings aren’t everything.
Try it if you want, they’re all over. I think GG is hiding one nearby.
If you need tips, just ask!
